   City Council Meeting Agenda
  Tuesday, March 17, 2020

   CALL TO ORDER
   PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE LED BY: Mayor Pu
   ROLL CALL: Mayor Pu, Vice Mayor Menchaca, Council Members Costanzo, Harrington,
  Liao

 1. APPROVAL OF AGENDA ORDER

 2. PRESENTATIONS – None.

 3. PUBLIC COMMENT

  This is the time set aside for members of the public to address the City Council on items
  of interest that are not on the Agenda, but are within the subject matter jurisdiction of
  the San Gabriel City Council. Pursuant to the Brown Act, the City Council cannot answer
  any questions or take any action until such time as the matter may appear as an item on
  a future agenda.

  Please be aware that all public comments will be limited to a maximum of three minutes.
  You will receive a 30-second warning as you approach the end of your time. As a
  reminder, please be respectful of all speakers regardless of the position they take on any
  items.

  If you wish to address the City Council, please complete a speaker’s request card and
  hand it to the clerk before the start of the meeting. When speaking, please state your
  NAME for the record.

 4. CONSENT CALENDAR

  All items listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and
  recommendations will be approved in one motion unless a member of the
  City Council or audience requests separate discussion.

  A. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  The minutes are a record of the official actions taken at the City Council meeting.

  1. Minutes of the City Council Special Meeting of February 18, 2020.
  2. Minutes of the City Council Regular Meeting of February 18, 2020.
  3. Minutes of the City Council Special Meeting of March 10, 2020.
  Recommended Action: Approval.

  B. MATERIAL DEMANDS

City Council Regular Meeting Agenda – March 17, 2020  2
   This is the presentation of the “Register of Demands and Warrants” for the payment
  of City expenditures.

  Recommended Action: Approval.

  C. CASH AND INVESTMENT REPORT – FEBRUARY 2020

  This is a presentation of City investments for the month of February 2020.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the Cash and Investment
  Report for February 2020.

  D. AWARD OF CONSTRUCTION CONTRACT FOR 2019 CDBG PEDESTRIAN RAMP
  IMPROVEMENT PROJECT, CONTRACT NO. 19-14

  There are a number of locations citywide where ADA ramps either do not exist or do
  not meet the latest federal and state requirement for ADA-compliant design. On
  November 21, 2019, the City received five bids, with CEM Construction Corporation
  as the lowest responsive bidder. The 2019 CDBG Pedestrian Ramp Improvement
  Project construction contract for $111,975 will be awarded to CEM Construction
  Corporation. This project will construct 22 new ADA pedestrian ramps.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council:

  1. Approve plans and specifications for the 2019 CDBG Pedestrian Ramp
  Improvement Project, Contract No. 19-14;

  2. Authorize the City Manager to execute contract documents with CEM
  Construction Corporation for the total bid amount in the amount of $111,975;
  and

  3. Approve a Purchase Order in the amount of $123,172.50 which includes a 10%
  construction contingency.

  E. SEWER SYSTEM CAPACITY ANALYSIS SOFTWARE & TRAINING

  The Public Works Department (Sewer Division) seeks to purchase proprietary
  capacity analysis software (InfoSewer) and staff training to identify capacity issues in
  the sanitary sewer system from Innovyze (Consultant) for $20,168.

  Recommended Action:
  Staff recommends that the City Council approve a purchase order not to exceed
  $20,168.00 using the Sewer Fund account 137-800-01-22-000.

City Council Regular Meeting Agenda – March 17, 2020  3
   F. ACCEPTANCE OF FINAL TRACT MAP NO. 73127 (1958 SOUTH CALIFORNIA
  STREET) PLANNING CASE NO. TMAP18-019

  City Council is requested to accept Final Tract Map No. 73127 and authorize filing
  with the Los Angeles County Recorder. The development, located at 1958 South
  California Street, is a five-unit condominium development on a 21,834 square foot
  lot. City Staff and the Los Angeles County Department of Public Works have reviewed
  the Final Parcel Map and have determined it is in compliance with the State
  Subdivision Map Act, conditions of approval, and the City’s ordinances regarding
  subdivision.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council accept Final Parcel Map No. 73127 and
  authorize filing with the Los Angeles County Recorder.

  G. AMENDMENT TO PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH ANNEALTA
  GROUP

  With the recent departure of the Planning Manager, the Planning Division is
  experiencing staffing challenges. In an attempt to temporarily fill this high-level
  management void, staff obtained an interim Planning Manager through the Annealta
  Group (Consultant) within the City Manager’s signature authority. The amendment
  to the PSA increases the original budget from $15,000 to $30,000. The budget for
  this Agreement is being absorbed from the salary savings generated due to several
  vacancies in the department.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council:

  1. Approve the Amendment to the Professional Services Agreement with Annealta
  Group; and

  2. Authorize the City Manager to execute all necessary documents.

  H. SECOND READING – ORDINANCE NO. 651 ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO 651
  - SAN GABRIEL PLAZA MIXED-USE PROJECT; REQUEST TO VACATE CITY
  STREETS, AND TENTATIVE TRACT MAP NO. 80292; ADOPTION OF MITIGATED
  NEGATIVE DECLARATION AND MITIGATION MONITORING AND REPORTING
  PROGRAM (PLANNING CASE NO. PL-16-162; 220 SOUTH SAN GABRIEL
  BOULEVARD)

  Ordinance No. 651 was introduced on February 18, 2020 by a 5-0 vote. Adoption of
  this Ordinance would approve the San Gabriel Plaza Mixed-Use Project: Planned
  Development, Development Agreement, Request to Vacate City Streets, and

City Council Regular Meeting Agenda – March 17, 2020  4
   Tentative Tract Map No. 80292; Adoption of Mitigated Negative Declaration and
  Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council:

  1. Waive the reading in full; and

  2. Adopt Ordinance No. 651 to adopt a mitigated negative declaration and
  mitigation, monitoring, and reporting program and to approve Project No. PL-
  16-162, a planned development, development agreement, request to vacate city
  streets, and Tentative Tract Map No. 80292 for the San Gabriel Plaza Mixed-Use
  project at 220 South San Gabriel Boulevard.

5.  PUBLIC HEARING – None.

6.  NEW BUSINESS

  A. 2019-2020 MIDYEAR BUDGET REPORT

  Pursuant to the City’s Fiscal Sustainability Policy adopted in April 2019, the City shall
  produce a midyear report apprising the City Council of the status of the current
  budget. This report/review is conducted to ensure that the revenue estimates and
  expenditure appropriations made during the formal budget process are
  synchronized with the actual revenue and expenditures anticipated by the year
  ending June 30, 2020. This review, with its corrective actions, also greatly assists the
  upcoming budget process due to the updating of all information.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council approve Resolution No. 20-09 which
  approves all necessary adjustments to the current revenue estimates and
  expenditure appropriations.

  B. ORDINANCE NO. 663 RESCINDING ORDINANCE NO. 558-C.S. AND
  ESTABLISHING LOCAL SPEED LIMITS BASED ON AN ENGINEERING AND
  TRAFFIC SURVEY

  The California Building Code Requires that local agencies establish speed limits for
  certain streets based upon an engineering and traffic survey. An engineering and
  traffic survey of thirty-three streets segments was completed in 2018. Based on the
  survey, eleven of the thirty-three street segments are recommended to have their
  speed limit increased by five miles per hour. Ordinance No. 663, amending Chapter
  73 – Traffic Schedule of the San Gabriel Municipal Code would establish the
  recommended speed limits determined by the engineering and traffic survey.

 City Council Regular Meeting Agenda – March 17, 2020  5
   Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council introduce Ordinance No. 663 for first reading
  by title only and waive further reading of the ordinance which establishes local speed
  limits and amends Schedule I of Chapter 73 – Traffic Schedules of the San Gabriel
  Municipal Code as shown in Exhibit C.

 7. PUBLIC COMMENT

 8. CITY MANAGER’S REPORT

 9. COUNCIL COMMENTS AND CONFERENCE/MEETING REPORTS

  Each Council Member may address the City Council and public on matters of general
  information and/or concern. This is also the time for Council Members to report on
  conferences and/or meetings they have attended.

 10. CLOSED SESSION – None.

 11. ADJOURNMENT

  The meeting will be adjourned in memory of Richard Coria. The next Regular City Council
  meeting will be held on Tuesday, April 7, 2020 at 6:30 p.m. in the Council Chamber at
  City Hall, 425 South Mission Drive, San Gabriel, California. Information regarding matters
  to be considered at each meeting will be available on the Friday before the City Council
  Meeting on the City’s website at www.sangabrielcity.com.
